install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# Prefer distro archives only — ignore broken third-party repos (exit 100).
apt_update_safe() {
  local opts=(-o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0)
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/debian.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kali.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/kali.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  apt-get update \
    -o Acquire::AllowInsecureRepositories=true \
    -o Acquire::AllowDowngradeToInsecureRepositories=true
}
apt_update_safe
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl
command -v curl >/dev/null
uninstall_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get remove -y curl || true
apt-get autoremove -y || true

custom_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# React Native Linux + Android env (https://reactnative.dev/docs/set-up-your-environment)
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_HOME}"
CMDLINE_ZIP_URL="${CMDLINE_ZIP_URL:-https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip}"
NODE_MAJOR_MIN=22
NODE_MINOR_MIN=11

pkg_install() {
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -y || true
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "$@"
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dnf install -y "$@"
  elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apk add --no-cache "$@"
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pacman -Sy --noconfirm "$@"
  else
    echo "unsupported package manager" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

echo "==> Ensuring base tools"
pkg_install ca-certificates curl wget unzip zip tar git procps || true

node_ok() {
  command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  local ver major minor
  ver="$(node -v | sed 's/^v//')"
  major="${ver%%.*}"
  minor="$(echo "$ver" | cut -d. -f2)"
  [ "$major" -gt "$NODE_MAJOR_MIN" ] && return 0
  [ "$major" -eq "$NODE_MAJOR_MIN" ] && [ "$minor" -ge "$NODE_MINOR_MIN" ]
}

if ! node_ok; then
  echo "==> Installing Node.js ${NODE_MAJOR_MIN}.x (>= ${NODE_MAJOR_MIN}.${NODE_MINOR_MIN} required)"
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_MAJOR_MIN}.x | bash -
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -fsSL https://rpm.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_MAJOR_MIN}.x | bash -
    dnf install -y nodejs
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pacman -Sy --noconfirm nodejs npm
  elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apk add --no-cache nodejs npm
  else
    export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.5/install.sh | bash
    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
    nvm install ${NODE_MAJOR_MIN}
    nvm alias default ${NODE_MAJOR_MIN}
  fi
else
  echo "==> Node already OK: $(node -v)"
fi

if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! java -version 2>&1 | grep -Eq 'version "17'; then
  echo "==> Installing OpenJDK 17"
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkg_install openjdk-17-jdk-headless openjdk-17-jdk || pkg_install openjdk-17-jdk
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkg_install java-17-openjdk-devel || pkg_install java-17-openjdk
  elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkg_install openjdk17-jdk
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkg_install jdk17-openjdk
  fi
else
  echo "==> JDK already present"
  java -version || true
fi

if [ -z "${JAVA_HOME:-}" ] || [ ! -d "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
  if [ -d /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64 ]; then
    export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
  elif [ -d /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk ]; then
    export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk
  elif command -v javac >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v javac)")")")"
  fi
fi
echo "==> JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-unset}"

echo "==> Installing Android SDK into $ANDROID_HOME"
mkdir -p "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools"
if [ ! -x "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  curl -fsSL "$CMDLINE_ZIP_URL" -o "$tmp/cmdline-tools.zip"
  unzip -q "$tmp/cmdline-tools.zip" -d "$tmp"
  rm -rf "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest"
  mkdir -p "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest"
  if [ -d "$tmp/cmdline-tools" ]; then
    cp -a "$tmp/cmdline-tools/." "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/"
  else
    cp -a "$tmp/." "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/"
  fi
  rm -rf "$tmp"
fi

export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$PATH"
SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: sdkmanager missing at $SDKMANAGER" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "==> Accepting Android SDK licenses"
yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" --licenses >/dev/null || true

echo "==> Installing Android SDK packages (Platform 35, Build-Tools 36.0.0, platform-tools)"
"$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" --install \
  "platform-tools" \
  "platforms;android-35" \
  "build-tools;36.0.0" \
  "cmdline-tools;latest" \
  "emulator" || true

install -d -m 755 /etc/profile.d
cat > /etc/profile.d/react-native-android.sh <<EOF
export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-}"
export ANDROID_HOME="$ANDROID_HOME"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="\$PATH:\$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin"
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/react-native-android.sh

RN_SNIPPET="
# React Native Android (https://reactnative.dev/docs/set-up-your-environment)
export JAVA_HOME=\"${JAVA_HOME:-}\"
export ANDROID_HOME=\"$ANDROID_HOME\"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=\"\$ANDROID_HOME\"
export PATH=\"\$PATH:\$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin\"
"
for profile in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.zshrc"; do
  touch "$profile"
  if ! grep -q 'ANDROID_HOME=.*/Android/Sdk' "$profile" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' "$RN_SNIPPET" >> "$profile"
  fi
done

if ! command -v watchman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "==> Watchman not found (optional). See https://facebook.github.io/watchman/"
fi

echo "==> Verifying toolchain"
command -v node >/dev/null && echo "node: $(node -v)"
command -v npm >/dev/null && echo "npm: $(npm -v)"
command -v java >/dev/null && java -version 2>&1 | head -n1 || true
command -v adb >/dev/null && echo "adb: $(adb version | head -n1)" || echo "adb: open a new shell to pick up PATH"
echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
echo "==> React Native Linux Android environment ready."
echo "    Create a project: npx @react-native-community/cli@latest init AwesomeProject"
echo "    Optional GUI: install Android Studio separately."
